headline: Vipul Organics Ltd partners with Global Specialty Materials Leader OMYA for Exclusive European Distribution of Pigments
summary: Indian specialty chemicals company Vipul Organics announced an exclusive distribution partnership with Swiss-based Omya for pigments in Europe. The deal aims to boost pigment sales across European manufacturers.
why: Omya is a Swiss producer of industrial minerals and specialty materials, and distribution agreements shape how chemical suppliers reach European customers.
